test_str_contains: test the pandas str.contains method for regex and literal pattern matching on string series
test_str_replace: test the pandas str.replace method for regex and literal string replacement with callable and dictionary patterns
test_str_match: test the pandas str.match method for full-string regex matching with case sensitivity and compiled patterns
test_str_fullmatch: test the pandas str.fullmatch method for complete string regex matching with escape sequences and flags
test_str_findall: test the pandas str.findall method for extracting all regex match groups from string series
